body:
12:15 am starting off with 5 350mg tablets as my toletolerance is high. Took on an empty stomach with water.
12:42 am euphoria kicks in. It's like taking a Percocet only you get shaky.
1:00 am euphoria is better than any opiate I've done but I have trouble walking. Soma gives shakes which is the only down fall.
1:30 am I am tired and relaxed.
My experience is great. It gives me a good euphoria but with shakes. That's my only down fall. Tolerance builds fast. Be ware. It's dangerous to take a lot of it.
